name: notion_search
description: Search all pages and databases shared with the integration by title; filter by object type and sort by last edited time (POST /v1/search)

query.description: The text that the API compares page and database titles against.

filter.description: A set of criteria that limits results to either only pages or only databases: {"value": "page"|"database", "property": "object"}.

sort.description: Criteria to order results by; only last_edited_time is supported: {"direction": "ascending"|"descending", "timestamp": "last_edited_time"}.

start_cursor.description: A cursor value returned in a previous response; results start after the cursor. Defaults to the first page of results.

page_size.description: The number of items from the full list to include in the response. Maximum: 100.
